purpose: Distinguish S03 obstacle/route stalling from final-goal settling failure in two current scratch candidates; screening CSVs have no terminal positions or trajectories
scope: Development diagnosis only, no training, no final test, no new cohort
intervention: Only turn on existing trajectory recording and progress diagnostics for original deterministic S03 screening; preserve Actor, task, sensor, control and case identities
measurements: case outcome consistency with existing screening
interpretation: Near-goal settling is supported only when trajectories actually approach the 0.5m goal region; persistent obstacle/local-route stalling requires an observed stationary segment far from goal. Timeouts alone distinguish neither. Differences between recording modes must be disclosed.
rejection: If the selected policies reach neither a stationary obstacle state nor the goal neighborhood, do not adopt either explanation; retain actual traces and describe observed behavior.
loading: Unselected checkpoints have full training payloads but no inference Actor export. Original CLI attempts failed before any rollout; collect.py uses the existing full-state loader and original parameters without exporting or altering the source.
loader_checks: resolved trainer configuration equals source metadata
full training tree shape and dtype verified by load_model_state
restored update counter equals source checkpoint provenance
